skill.name: defi-protocols
skill.description: Integration expertise for major DeFi protocols including Uniswap, Aave, Compound, Chainlink, Curve, and Balancer. Supports swaps, liquidity provision, lending, borrowing, oracles, and flash loans.

generated_query: I'm building a DeFi arbitrage bot that executes a flash loan from Aave, then swaps assets on Uniswap V3, and finally supplies the profit to Compound. For example: flash borrow 100,000 USDC, swap it for DAI on Uniswap V3 (0.05% fee pool) in a single trade, then supply the DAI to Compound to earn supply interest, and repay the flash loan plus fee. I also need to integrate a Chainlink price feed to check if the swap price is within a safe range before executing. Can you help me write the Solidity contract? I need the full implementation including interfaces for Aave Pool, Uniswap V3 SwapRouter, Compound cToken, and Chainlink AggregatorV3, along with the flash loan callback and proper error handling. Please provide the code with specific addresses on Ethereum mainnet for these protocols.
